subject: #1912 (tick results 20261107T024558Z) held: its objective-state snapshot claims 100% on a tree that measures lower
body: Codex's P2 on #1912 (docs/agent/objective-state.json, comment 4500251747) blocks the merge (thread resolution is required) and the cloud will not resolve it: the snapshot records readiness 100% and marks evidence-fresh met, derived against 5be2e5b, but the published tree after the mainline merges reports a lower figure (Codex measured 95%, Browser E2E step missing, 27/28 launch items current). Landing it would put a false 'met' on mainline. The cloud could not re-derive it here (check-readiness-figure needs the simulator run, which this lane did not repeat). Please re-run the tick's objective-loop --write on the current tree and push, or close #1912 and let the next tick carry fresh results; the sim results themselves are fine.
